name: Rookie Raiders
storyline: Rookies seeking their own goals venture into dangerous dungeons in pursuit of wealth, answers, and adventure. As different companions travel together, their stories unfold through encounters determined by the party, dungeon, and items chosen during each run.
summary: Rookies, raid the dungeons — claim your wealth and fame! Craft your own builds with a cast of one-of-a-kind characters and complete your party. Everything runs on your design. Rookie Raiders — the fully automated combat roguelite RPG!
